description: BTC-first delayed outward reacceptance after completed external-liquidity reclaim

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged 6 bp. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop execution reserves the shifted prior-hour ten-second true-range Q99. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding and applies native liquidation.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted prior-60-minute ten-second true-range Q99, minimum one tick; independent of signal outcome.

validation_protocol.pattern_detector: Already-completed 4-hour/day/week external-liquidity inventory remains independent from the delayed-reacceptance scenario.
validation_protocol.initial_response: A complete strictly post-interaction 30-second outward initiative response closes outside the boundary, but does not enter.
validation_protocol.reclaim: Price later closes back through the interacted boundary before the active external target is reached; the complete observed counter-auction is frozen.
validation_protocol.reacceptance: A separate complete strictly post-reclaim 30-second outward initiative response closes outside the boundary and breaks the frozen counter-auction extreme.
validation_protocol.entry: Market OUO bracket only after completed delayed reacceptance.
validation_protocol.sizing: Current full shared USDT NAV times 3 percent divided by expected entry-to-stop loss including both 6 bp fill charges, one adverse entry tick, causal Q99 stop reserve and causal funding reserve; no nominal cap or score multiplier.
validation_protocol.stop: Beyond the observed counter-auction extreme or reclaimed boundary, whichever is farther, plus the existing ATR structural buffer and minimum distance.
validation_protocol.target: The active completed external target selected at the initial outward response; reject if it is reached before entry. No fitted R fallback.
validation_protocol.setup_expiry: Four hours from the first completed external-level interaction.
validation_protocol.global_selection: At any timestamp only the highest causal cost-after net reward-risk signal is eligible; while any order or position exists the account is unavailable.
validation_protocol.promotion: The fixed first BTC week must pass before the remaining two fixed BTC weeks; all three must pass unchanged before multiasset or long evaluation.
validation_protocol.single_ablation: After a clean logic failure, remove only the initial initiative-state strength requirement while retaining outward direction, boundary reclaim, second initiative reacceptance, target, stop, costs, 3 percent sizing and all execution contracts. Diagnostic evidence is never directly promotable.
validation_protocol.event_chain: Research evidence must preserve IDLE -> INTERACTION_ARMED -> INITIAL_OUTWARD_RESPONSE -> BOUNDARY_RECLAIMED -> CONFIRMED without collapsing observable states.
